title: FORK THEORY
description: ForkTheory is a strategy-led restaurant consultancy that transforms culinary ideas into high-performing, scalable food businesses. We specialize in concept development, menu engineering, kitchen systems, operational excellence, staff training, and growth strategy — combining creativity with data, discipline with design, and passion with performance. From startups to multi-unit brands, ForkTheory builds restaurants that launch stronger, operate smarter, and scale sustainably while delivering exceptional guest experiences and measurable financial results.
